ai_summary: AAVAS FINANCIERS LIMITED announced significant board and executive changes, promoting Mr. Manu Yeshpal Singh to Managing Director & CEO and appointing Mr. Sanjeev Srinivasan as a Non-Executive Nominee Director for five-year terms. These appointments, effective September 19, 2026, follow prior RBI approval and replace a resigning director, signaling a strategic leadership refresh and continuity in governance. No immediate red flags are apparent, as the changes leverage experienced professionals and are subject to routine shareholder approval.
